tasks.label: Vue: Stop Dev Server
tasks.detail: Windows: stop only Vite dev servers belonging to this workspace.
args: $projectRoot = $env:VUE_PROJECT_ROOT + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar; $viteScript = [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar + [IO.Path]::Combine('vite', 'bin', 'vite.js'); $servers = @(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name = 'node.exe'" | Where-Object { if (-not $_.CommandLine) { return $false }; $commandLine = $_.CommandLine.Replace([char]47, [char]92); $commandLine.IndexOf($projectRoot, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -and $commandLine.IndexOf($viteScript, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -ge 0 -and $commandLine -notmatch ' (?:build|preview)(?: |$)' }); if ($servers.Count -eq 0) { Write-Output 'No Vite dev server found for this workspace.' } else { $servers | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output ('Stopped workspace Vite server (PID {0}).' -f $_.ProcessId) } }
